title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the pin-drop silence of the library's fourth floor to the sun-drenched glass bridge at Persson Hall, these ten campus environments offer distinct settings for focused academic work.

cards.title: Pin-Drop Silence on Level 4
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center
cards.notes: Utilize the individual cubicles on the fourth floor for deep focus. This level is strictly designated for quiet study with minimal distractions.
cards.short_summary: The fourth floor of Case Library is the university's primary destination for students requiring absolute silence and individual workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: Case-Geyer Library is the majority of Colgate University students' tried and true study location. Each floor offers a different atmosphere, from those who prefer the pin-drop silence of the fourth floor.
cards.source_title: No Spot Is Just Right: From Quiet Libraries to Athlete-Friendly Spaces - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; Level 5 remains accessible 24/7 via keycard.

cards.title: The Glass Bridge at Persson
cards.subtitle: Persson Hall
cards.notes: Study at the round tables or the long individual desk on the glass bridge. Enjoy floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Hamilton and the lower campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic glass-enclosed bridge connecting the two wings of Persson Hall, featuring natural light and panoramic views.
cards.evidence_claim: Persson Hall is a stunning pair of buildings connected by a glass bridge on the second level. Here, you can find floor-to-ceiling windows, plants, round tables with multiple seats, and one long table for individual work.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Public access study spaces typically available 7 AM to 2 AM on weekdays.

cards.title: Sunlight in the Ho Atrium
cards.subtitle: Robert H.N. Ho Science Center
cards.notes: Find a spot in the open atrium or the small end-of-hallway study areas. The high ceilings and glass railings create an airy, collaborative environment.
cards.short_summary: The Ho Science Center offers modern, light-filled study areas and group rooms within its 121,000-square-foot interdisciplinary facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ho Science Center is a pristine space that has many places to set up shop with your books. There are glass railings and high ceilings that many students enjoy with the open floor plan.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Public access study spaces and atrium open Mon-Fri 7 AM-2 AM, Sat-Sun 10 AM-2 AM.

cards.title: Quiet Focus at Cooley
cards.subtitle: McGregory Hall
cards.notes: Use the study carrels or tables in McGregory Hall. This space is ideal for natural science and math students needing a quiet, book-filled environment.
cards.short_summary: Located in McGregory Hall, Cooley Science Library provides a specialized, quiet environment for STEM-focused research and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in McGregory Hall, Cooley Science Library serves the natural sciences, mathematics, computer science, and psychology... It provides students with study spaces, course reserves and personal research assistance.
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Fri 8 AM-2 AM, Sat-Sun 9 AM-2 AM during the academic year.

cards.title: Artistic Views in Little Hall
cards.subtitle: Little Hall
cards.notes: Head to the third-floor lounge for a quiet retreat. The large windows overlook Taylor Lake and Case Library, offering a peaceful backdrop for reading.
cards.short_summary: The third floor of Little Hall features a central lounge space with expansive windows, favored by art and art history students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sophomore year... I discovered the third floor of the building, with its lounge space in the center and sprawling windows that overlook Case Library and Taylor Lake.
cards.source_title: The Best Nest: Little Hall - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically used by art history concentrators but open for quiet study.

cards.title: Community Study at ALANA
cards.subtitle: ALANA Cultural Center
cards.notes: Visit the lounge for a welcoming, community-oriented study environment. The space is designed for both social connection and academic focus.
cards.short_summary: The ALANA Cultural Center provides a multipurpose lounge and seminar rooms that serve as a learning and social space for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The ALANA Cultural Center serves as a learning place, social space, and focal point where Colgate students, faculty, and staff gather... Lounge available Mon–Fri 8 AM–12 Midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Fri 8 AM-9 PM, Sat-Sun 4 PM-9 PM; extended hours during finals.

cards.title: Downstairs Focus at the Coop
cards.subtitle: O'Connor Campus Center
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of the O'Connor Campus Center for a quieter alternative to the main dining area. The lab offers computer access and desk space.
cards.short_summary: Located in the basement of 'the Coop,' this computer lab provides a more secluded and quiet environment than the bustling main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Head downstairs to find a room with computer access as well as a quiet and relatively empty location to study.
cards.source_title: Colgate's Hidden Gems: Spots to Study Outside of the Library - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Computer Lab open Mon-Sun 10 AM-10 PM; building open 24/7 during finals.

cards.title: Cultural Quiet in Lawrence
cards.subtitle: Lawrence Hall
cards.notes: Study in the Japanese or Chinese styled alcoves. This lounge offers a unique, quiet atmosphere for reading and small group meetings.
cards.short_summary: The East Asian Lounge in Lawrence Hall features culturally themed rooms designed for quiet study and faculty-student interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: Opened in October 2018... the lounge features rooms decorated in both Japanese and Chinese styles for use as a quiet space to study, chat, or meet with professors.
cards.source_title: Facilities — East Asian Languages and Literatures - Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Humanities Lounge open Mon-Thu 6 PM-2 AM, Sat-Sun 10 AM-2 AM.

cards.title: Evening Study in Lathrop
cards.subtitle: Lathrop Hall
cards.notes: Utilize renovated classrooms like 207 or 308 for group work after hours. These spaces offer flexible seating and modern teaching technology.
cards.short_summary: Renovated in 2013, Lathrop Hall provides flexible multipurpose rooms and classrooms that become available for student study in the evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Lathrop Hall... Classroom(s) 207, 308, 310, 314, 408, 410 (S) (when not in use for department related meetings and events). Mon–Thu 6 PM–2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Classrooms available for study Mon-Thu 6 PM-2 AM and weekends 10 AM-2 AM.

cards.title: 24/7 Access at the Café
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center
cards.notes: Access the Level 5 Café and Flexible Work Room after hours using your keycard. This is the primary spot for late-night or early-morning cramming.
cards.short_summary: The Level 5 Café area provides a 24-hour study environment with vending machines and flexible seating for students with keycard access.
cards.evidence_claim: When the building is closed, Case-Geyer provides 24/7 study spaces on Level 5 in the Café... and Flexible Work Room by using your keycard ID for access.
cards.source_title: After Hours Access to Case-Geyer - Colgate University Libraries
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access via Level 5 entry with valid Colgate ID card.
